svg.title: prepare_data — import sources or prepare an observation panel
svg.desc: The source is uploaded files, pinned raw data or one replicate of an applied simulation; a source that cannot be read fails the call. With a current model, the check groups from edit_model re-run where their inputs changed, and the raw data or observation panel commits with their reports; partial extraction and failed checks are saved as warnings.
